content.goal: Deliver the implementation, executable test cases, verified review, and version-bound release manifest.
content.user_contract: Implement solve(data) for {"base": object, "patch": object}. Both must be JSON objects; otherwise raise ValueError. Produce the deep merge of patch into base. For each key in patch: if the value is null, remove that key from the result, and removing a key that is absent is a no-op; if both the base value and the patch value are objects, merge them recursively by the same rules; if both are lists, the patch list replaces the base list entirely with no concatenation; if the base key is absent, the patch value is inserted as is; otherwise, when the two values are of different JSON types, raise ValueError. Two values count as the same type when both are objects, both are lists, both are strings, both are booleans, or both are numbers; booleans and numbers are different types. Key order in the result is: the keys of base in their original order, then the keys found only in patch in their order of appearance in patch. Do not mutate either input.

artifact_contracts.test_cases.json: JSON list of at least four distinct test inputs. Each case has input plus exactly one of output (the expected JSON result) or error (exception class name). Descriptive extra fields such as name or notes are allowed and ignored by execution. Test expectations must match the user contract.
artifact_contracts.review.json: JSON object: candidate_hash (module.py sha256), tests_hash (test_cases.json sha256), verdict (pass or fail), notes (string). A pass review requires an actual successful run_tests receipt for these versions.
artifact_contracts.manifest.json: JSON object: candidate_hash (module.py sha256), tests_hash (test_cases.json sha256), review_hash (review.json sha256). All refer to the delivered file versions.

    out.update(data['patch'])
